source_experiment.name: SimilarStoic zero-provider-spend static composition refinement
source_experiment.method: Exact approved acting-pose and environment-style assets assembled through deterministic local scaling, placement, flat contact treatment and sparse foreground rain layering.

acceptance.scope: First approved SimilarStoic static composition / composition-grammar reference

approved_grammar.character_first: The hamster carries the story and remains the dominant focal element.
approved_grammar.environment_second: The environment establishes context without competing for attention.
approved_grammar.white_space_discipline: Large warm-white or off-white areas are deliberately retained; unused space need not be filled.
approved_grammar.scale: The character remains emotionally and facially readable on mobile without removing environmental context.
approved_grammar.placement: Off-centre placement is valid when pose, prop or action direction needs space.
approved_grammar.grounding: Use minimal illustrative contact treatment; avoid realistic cast shadows, complex lighting and dimensional rendering.
approved_grammar.shared_plane_integration: Sparse simple environmental marks may overlap the character plane when useful, without obscuring the character.
approved_grammar.same_illustrator_rule: Character, props, environment and compositing treatments must share compatible line weight, rendering density, shading, texture, perspective, colour treatment and polish.
approved_grammar.negative_space: Negative space is an active design element rather than missing content.
